standard-dialogue-normal-variant.player: So you're made entirely of rocks?

standard-dialogue-normal-variant.npc: Not quite, my body is formed mostly of minerals.
No, rocks are rocks, minerals are minerals. I am formed from minerals.
Yes, I am. This conversation seems to be confusing you; perhaps you should stop.

standard-dialogue-tin-variant.npc: I feel strangely emotionless and empty. Maybe I should feel sad about it, but I can't.
Correct. Now, if I only had a heart...

standard-dialogue-tin-variant.player: I'm not sure it works like that around here.

standard-dialogue-copper-variant.npc: I have an idea for a song.
Copper-copper-copper Cophelia - you come and go, you come and go...

standard-dialogue-iron-variant.npc: Truth is, I am Iron Golem.

standard-dialogue-blurite-variant.npc: I have an idea for a song.

standard-dialogue-silver-variant.npc: Oh dear, I've gone all pale.
It must be something I ate.

standard-dialogue-daeyalt-variant.npc: Did you ever hear the tragedy of Queen Efaritay the Fair?
It's not a story the Myreque would tell you.

standard-dialogue-coal-variant.npc: So near and yet so far... if my atoms were arranged a little differently, I could be diamond.

standard-dialogue-coal-variant.player: Would you enjoy being a diamond?

standard-dialogue-coal-variant.npc: I expect I would, until someone tried chipping bits off me with a chisel. I'm probably safer as coal.

standard-dialogue-elemental-variant.npc: I am so in my element right now.

standard-dialogue-gold-variant.npc: I'm totally showing the bling today.
A little. Though sometimes I just feel like I'm being used as a status symbol, and no-one appreciates me for me.
Don't worry. At least I look good.

standard-dialogue-granite-variant.npc: I know how it works. No-one actually wants granite. They just chop us up and throw our pieces on the floor.

standard-dialogue-granite-variant.player: Oh, I can see that must be upsetting for you.

standard-dialogue-granite-variant.npc: When you've seen your relatives cut into pieces, with their severed limbs cast aside like junk, THEN you will understand how I feel.

standard-dialogue-mithril-variant.npc: I feel sad today. Very blue.

standard-dialogue-lovakite-variant.player: So how do you pronounce Lovakengj?

standard-dialogue-lovakite-variant.npc: How did you not know that?

standard-dialogue-lovakite-variant.player: You know, it really isn't that obvious.

standard-dialogue-adamantite-variant.npc: I may be green, but I'm not an environmentalist.
There's no need. Whatever you may have read, even coal is a renewable energy source - just wait a minute and the rocks respawn.
You can burn as much as you like, too, without needing to worry about it affecting the climate - we don't have a lot of weather here.
Yes, I pity anyone whose world doesn't work like this one. I don't know how they can possibly cope.

standard-dialogue-runite-variant.npc: I'm confused. It takes incredible skill to smith anything from my ore, yet the items you'd get are terribly mediocre.

standard-dialogue-runite-variant.player: Is that something that worries you?

standard-dialogue-runite-variant.npc: It just feels like my world doesn't make sense, sometimes. But I suppose it's always been like this, and I've got used to it.

standard-dialogue-amethyst-variant.npc: Your world is amazing. I truly am in awe.

standard-dialogue-amethyst-variant.player: Did you just make an ore joke?

standard-dialogue-amethyst-variant.npc: Ha! Now you're making them as well.

standard-dialogue-amethyst-variant.player: Are we really doing this? Amethyst isn't an ore anyway.

standard-dialogue-lead-variant.npc: Why am I the one always following you?
Well I'm the lead golem, so surely I should take the lead!

standard-dialogue-lead-variant.player: That joke doesn't even make sense... Those words aren't pronounced the same!

standard-dialogue-lead-variant.npc: Well, blame whoever decided they should have the same spelling then.

standard-dialogue-nickel-variant.npc: I reckon I'd make a good thief.
Maybe, but if I was one, I'd be able to nickel they have!

standard-dialogue-rubium-variant.player: What's wrong? Are you doing a barbarian impression?

standard-dialogue-rubium-variant.npc: I FEEL SO ALIVE, SO CHARGED UP! I'M BRIMMING WITH POTENTIAL ENERGY! LET'S RUN, GO FASTER!

standard-dialogue-rubium-variant.player: Maybe you should cool off? How about a swim?
